test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven friends, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. P and R are the neighbours of N. S is sitting second to the left of N. O is sitting between R and Q.

Who is sitting second to the right of O?
solution: Seven friends, **M, N, O, P, Q, R and S**, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. 1. S is sitting second to the left of N. 2. P and R are the neighbours of N.
